get.description: Every event carries a replay cursor as SSE `id` and a CheckEvent as JSON `data`. Send a Check-bound `Last-Event-ID` cursor (including `{checkId}:0` for full replay) to receive Check-bound SSE IDs. Legacy numeric cursors and numeric SSE IDs remain supported; numeric cursors apply only to the authorized Check in the URL. The stream closes after the event that ends the Check, or silently on expiry, current denial or authority outage. Every frame and heartbeat requires current authority.
